files_summary.employees.csv: CSV file containing a subset of Enron employee records (employee ID, first name, last name, up to three email addresses, folder identifier, and status). Extracted from the public Enron employee directory dataset.
files_summary.sample_email.eml: Raw .eml email file (RFC 822 format) representing a realistic inbound email sample. Includes standard headers (From, To, Subject, Message-ID, Date, MIME-Version, Content-Type) and a plain‑text body. Sourced from a public GitHub sample email used for testing spam‑block scripts.
files_summary.emails.json: JSON array of five realistic email objects, each with fields: email_id, folder (INBOX or Sent), from, to, subject, date (ISO‑8601), body (multi‑line text), attachments (empty array), and read status (boolean). The data combines employee email addresses from the CSV with sample conversation threads and the sample .eml content to provide a rich, logically consistent email environment.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: load_employees_csv
tool_schemas.description: Loads employee records from the CSV at the given path and returns a list of employee objects, optionally capped by limit. It refuses requests where the path cannot be read as a valid employees CSV or where limit is not a non-negative integer. It also refuses when limit exceeds what the service can process in one request or when the CSV has no readable rows.

path.description: Path to the CSV file. Defaults to '/app/database/employees.csv'.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. If omitted, all rows are returned.

tool_schemas.name: get_employee_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns a single employee record matching the given employee_id from the CSV at the provided path. It refuses requests with a missing or empty employee_id, or where the CSV path cannot be read as a valid employees CSV. It also refuses when no employee record exists for that employee_id or when multiple rows conflict for the same identifier.

employee_id.description: The employee ID to look up.

path.description: Path to the CSV file. Defaults to '/app/database/employees.csv'.

tool_schemas.name: parse_sample_email
tool_schemas.description: Parses the .eml file at the given path and returns extracted message headers along with the plain-text body. It refuses requests where the path cannot be read, the content is not a valid RFC 5322 email message, or the message lacks headers/body that can be parsed. It also refuses when the message does not contain a plain-text part that can be returned as the body.

path.description: Path to the .eml file. Defaults to '/app/database/sample_email.eml'.

tool_schemas.name: load_emails_json
tool_schemas.description: Loads email objects from the JSON dataset at the given path and returns a list of emails, optionally capped by limit. It refuses requests where the path cannot be read as a valid emails dataset or where limit is not a non-negative integer. It also refuses when the JSON content is not an array of email objects or when limit exceeds what the service can return in one request.

path.description: Path to the JSON file. Defaults to '/app/database/emails.json'.

limit.description: Maximum number of email objects to return. If omitted, all emails are returned.

tool_schemas.name: get_email_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the single email object whose email_id matches the provided value from the JSON dataset at the given path. It refuses requests with a missing or empty email_id, or where the dataset path cannot be read as a valid emails JSON file. It also refuses when no email exists for that email_id or when the dataset contains conflicting duplicates for the same email_id.

email_id.description: The unique identifier of the email to retrieve.

path.description: Path to the JSON file. Defaults to '/app/database/emails.json'.

metadata.name: Mailbox Archive Gateway
metadata.description: Provides simple endpoints to ingest email records from JSON/CSV sources, parse sample message artifacts, and retrieve individual email or employee entries by ID.
